topics.label: Scholarly metadata
topics.description: Bibliographic records for articles, reports and books: DOI, title, authors, venue, year, abstract, references and citations. Used to find and identify literature; not itself quotable evidence.
topics.objective: Pilot question: What barriers do electrical panel and service capacity create for replacing gas appliances with heat pumps, HPWHs and induction in existing US single-family homes, and what workarounds are documented? Stage: search and de-duplicate candidate literature (building-science, energy-policy and housing journals, conference papers, lab reports) by DOI.

topics.label: Open-access discovery
topics.description: Locating a legal, free-to-read copy of a known work (publisher OA, repository preprint or accepted manuscript) and its licence.
topics.objective: Pilot question: What barriers do electrical panel and service capacity create for replacing gas appliances with heat pumps, HPWHs and induction in existing US single-family homes, and what workarounds are documented? Stage: for each candidate DOI, find a lawful OA copy before spending any institutional or keyed access.

topics.label: Full-text retrieval
topics.description: Fetching the bytes of an article (PDF, XML, HTML) so quotations can be verified against stored source bytes (UPC).
topics.objective: Pilot question: What barriers do electrical panel and service capacity create for replacing gas appliances with heat pumps, HPWHs and induction in existing US single-family homes, and what workarounds are documented? Stage: pull each selected paper into the project's UPC corpus so every quote about panel upgrades, service limits and workarounds passes the byte-for-byte gate.

topics.label: Institutional access
topics.description: Subscription content reached through an entitlement: a publisher API key (optionally with an institutional token) or the UC Davis Library's IP/SSO entitlement.
topics.objective: Pilot question: What barriers do electrical panel and service capacity create for replacing gas appliances with heat pumps, HPWHs and induction in existing US single-family homes, and what workarounds are documented? Stage: retrieve the version of record for paywalled papers that the OA route could not supply, within the licence and politeness rules.

notes: Hand-authored for the Hermes deep-research pilot (roadmap item 1). Topics describe the retrieval stages of a literature pipeline, not the subject matter; subject scoping is done per query.
